description: 從事農牧業之人工鋪面面積按主要灌溉水源分 [irrigation] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 行政院主計總處. 農林漁牧業普查之農牧業有從事農牧業生產或提供休閒服務者，觀察其運用人工鋪面面積(含自有自用及非自有)，並呈現主要灌溉水源情形. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 行政院主計總處. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2024-09-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support irrigation network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
